results.title: Capterra Review 2026: Pricing, Features & Alternatives – Slicey Tools
results.snippet: Getting a base listing is free, but visibility — placement in category rankings, "badges," and lead delivery — runs through paid programs sold by Gartner Digital Markets sales reps. There is no self-serve rate card; the account team quotes pricing per vendor, and the market convention (reported broadly across marketing and SaaS forums, not published by Capterra itself) is cost-per-click or cost-per-lead rather than a flat subscription.
